titre: Control test n°1 — English (4th year primary, first year)

exercices.enonce:
Greetings. Match the question to the answer. Write the letter.
1) Hello!
2) What is your name?
3) How are you?

a) My name is Sam.
b) Hello!
c) I am fine.

1 ← ....   2 ← ....   3 ← ....

Numbers 1-10.
1) Circle the correct number: (2 points)
- three ← ( 2 / 3 / 5 )
- one ← ( 1 / 4 / 6 )
- six ← ( 2 / 6 / 9 )
2) Write the number in letters: (2 points)
2 = ..........   5 = ..........

The alphabet.
1) Write the missing letters: (2 points)
a, ...., c, ...., e, ....
2) Complete: (2 points)
g, h, ...., j    and    m, ...., o

About you. Complete. (4 points)
1) Hello! My name is .......... .
2) I am .......... years old. (write a number)

Colours and classroom objects.
1) Circle the correct colour: (2 points)
- The apple is ( red / blue / green ).
- The banana is ( yellow / black / white ).
2) Complete with: pen - book - bag. (2 points)
a) I write with a .......... .
b) I carry my things in a .......... .
